Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the slot yesterday — the team found the initial overview helpful. Two follow-ups from my side:

1) We've pulled in Security and Procurement stakeholders for evaluation. Security wants a short technical walkthrough focused on data flow and key management, and Procurement needs a pricing/terms + contract timeline discussion.

2) A few people are traveling next week (EMEA folks on customer site Thu–Fri), so we may need either (a) a split approach — a 30-min infra/security deep-dive and a separate 45-min procurement + commercial session — or (b) shift the full, longer demo after travel.

Can you propose a plan? Suggested windows that work for our core panel (London timezone):
- Tue 6 Jul: 10:00–12:00 BST (tight, several people only available 10:00–10:45)
- Wed 7 Jul: 14:00–16:00 BST
- Mon 12 Jul: mornings only (09:00–11:00 BST)

We'd prefer the split sessions so security can get technical time without dragging procurement into every deep kernel discussion. Happy to share attendee list if that helps.

Best,
